Actually, the concern: my C core computes the U table for all (b,e) pairs. For each (b,e) it does O(nb + ne) work where nb = nd[b] and ne = nd[e]. With 2048 prefixes spread over lengths 1..128, nd[d] could be ~2048 for most d. So the total work = Σ_b Σ_e (nd[b] + nd[e]) ≈ 128*32*2048*2 = 16.8M operations. That's fast in C (~0.1 s).
